question: Should TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload become the permanent public plugin-SDK contract for channel-owned tool-progress chrome?
rationale: The bug fix is technically coherent, but repository policy treats new plugin API surface as compatibility-sensitive; automated checks cannot determine whether this generic contract should be supported for third-party plugins.

options.title: Accept the generic SDK intent
options.body: Keep the public constant and predicate, require exact-head lifecycle proof, and define their distinct channel-owned progress semantics.

options.title: Keep the contract internal
options.body: Expose a narrower internal or injected runtime seam for bundled Codex and Slack without adding third-party plugin API.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave current Slack behavior unchanged until maintainers choose a broader portable progress-action design.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic SDK intent
recommendation.body: Keep the public constant and predicate, require exact-head lifecycle proof, and define their distinct channel-owned progress semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work spans both Codex app-server behavior and Slack delivery, making this the best available owner for the cross-boundary API choice.
